verdict.rationale: Mirrors' first-party docs describe an official SDK: you install an npm package and connect your agent's prompt and capture hooks. The docs also describe concrete SDK behavior, including a configurable per-turn timeout of at most 1,000 ms, background snapshot capture, a final execution capture, and appending matched guidance to the next request's system prompt. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond the single npm/JavaScript package (e.g. Python), a detailed SDK API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
